hypothesis: A first expansion of combined USD and JPY cross-pair dispersion above its trailing 120-H1 75th percentile creates USDJPY direction in the contemporaneous H1 aggregate-pressure direction.
entry_rules: At minute 00, combined 1h USD+JPY dispersion crosses above causal rolling q75; BUY/SELL by current H1 pressure sign; non-overlap.
exit_rules: Existing 2ATR SL, 3ATR TP, max 48 M5, actual time-exit R.
fold_definition: Four fixed chronological test folds; validation skipped; 48-row end gap.
acceptance_criteria: Existing protocol gates including 3/4 folds, PF>=1.20, LCB>0, DD<=15R, concentration/direction and neighbor stability.
rejection_criteria: Any gate fails; neighbors cannot replace primary.
stopping_criteria: Complete fixed primary and simultaneous neighbors only.
